summary: Porting the FFT ocean from WebGL2 / three 0.180 to WebGPU / TSL on three r186 as the @dreamp/world-ocean engine module. Low tier first, then medium, high and ultra; each piece is built, then reviewed against the WebGL reference by a separate critic until it passes.

shots.label: Milestone: first WebGPU FFT ocean (C1 storm camera, interim material, no foam history yet)
shots.caption: GPU FFT fields match the CPU core to 4e-7 of Hs on every tier

pieces.name: Infra: package scaffold, contract stubs, demo shell, capture harness, reference captures
pieces.verdict: Headless Edge gets the RTX 2070 WebGPU adapter; 27 reference shots captured; demo shell renders via WebGPU

pieces.name: Core: JONSWAP spectrum, CPU FFT, WATER_QUERY, presets, Node tests
pieces.verdict: Round 1 FAIL: fidelity and determinism verified, but tick + gameplay queries average 10.4 ms (p99 20 ms) because velocityAt fills whole frames; small per-tick allocations. Builder sent back.

pieces.name: Reference analysis of the WebGL ocean (feature checklist)
pieces.verdict: 27-item visual checklist F1–F27, 7 canonical cameras; reference Hs 2.18 / 2.58 / 4.07 m

pieces.name: GPU FFT in TSL compute, all four tiers
pieces.verdict: Builder: GPU = CPU fields to 4e-7 Hs; 0.24–0.88 ms GPU per tier; async tier switch ~1.2 s, old tier stays on screen

pieces.name: Camera-relative LOD mesh + floating origin
pieces.verdict: Round 1 FAIL: watertight and origin-exact, but the horizon skirt depends on camera.far (gap at far=5000, vanishes at far=Infinity); tier change stalls 21–68 ms. Builder sent back.

pieces.name: Water material: reflection, sun, body colour, SSS
Medium / high / ultra tiers + async tier switch

perf.name: WebGL reference, default storm view (uncapped)
perf.notes: p95 17.1 ms from wave texture rebuild spikes; no GPU timestamps in WebGL

perf.name: WebGL reference, high view looking down (uncapped)

checks.name: Runs on WebGPU, three r186, no WebGL/GLSL/ShaderMaterial
Core runs in Node; tests pass; no three import outside three/ and demo/
Determinism: same seed + time → identical heights
Wind coupling changes spectrum, blends without pops
CPU = GPU: ?parity max error < 2 % of Hs
Far from origin (100 km): identical surface, parity passes
Motion vectors correct in velocity debug view
Cost table per tier in TUNING.md

issues.text: Core tick costs 2–4.5 ms CPU with 6–16 ms spikes; under review.
Spec test command 'node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/' fails on Node 22.14 (directory argument); works with a glob. Engine targets Node 24.

log.text: Core, LOD and GPU FFT built. FFT ocean renders on WebGPU at all four tiers. Critics reviewing core, LOD and FFT; material and foam builders started.
Read the spec, surveyed the WebGL reference, started infra, core and reference-analysis agents in parallel.
